import sys, torch
from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
ck_path = hf_hub_download("jaivial/dna-diskchat-2b-peer-v21", "checkpoints/final_113738.pt")              # 2.93 GB
sys.path.insert(0, <snapshot>/scripts)                      # repo scripts hardcode /root/dna
from model_dna_peer_v21 import DnaPeerV21, peer_counts
ck  = torch.load(ck_path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
cfg = ck["config"]      # {vocab:32000, d:512, layers:16, ff:1536, a:2048, b:2048,
                        #   nk:704, dk:128, topk:8, pheads:1, peer_layers:[4,8,12]}
model = DnaPeerV21(**cfg)
missing, unexpected = model.load_state_dict(ck["model"], strict=False)
model.eval()
# DnaChat has no forward(); features() + head2 is the entry point
h, balance, rows = model.features(ids)
logits = model.head2(h)

shared_expert_pool.note: ONE pool of nk^2 = 704^2 = 495616 rank-1 experts, shared by the 3 PEER layers [4, 8, 12]. Each expert is a rank-1 MLP: row i of pool.up (d=512, the 'read' direction) and row i of pool.down (d=512, the 'write'/value direction). pool.down rows are the VALUES in our sense.
shared_expert_pool.alias_note: the per-block blocks.{4,8,12}.ffn.pool.* entries are the SAME shared module saved once per block; at load time they are one tensor (verified below)

peer_tensors.product_key_note: Ka / Kb are the two halves of the product key: [pheads, nk, dk] = [1, 704, 128]. expert_id = argtop(qa.Ka)*nk + argtop(qb.Kb), so Ka x Kb addresses nk^2 experts. Keys are PER LAYER; the value pool is SHARED.

separate_codon_memory_table.note: this is the model's OTHER memory: the DNA codon table, a=2048 x b=2048 = 4,194,304 rows x 128 uint8 codons, decoded through a 4 x 256 x 4 positional codebook. Separate from the PEER expert pool.
